rows.text: when bit 0 of byte `rcx+0x57E` is set and the call at `002BE290` + 0x12 (`rcx` unchanged) returns non-null, makes the call at `002BE290` + 0x22 with (`rcx`, that result); then, when p = qword `rcx+0x570` is non-null and word `p+0x280` has bit 0 clear and bit 2 set, makes the call at `002BE290` + 0x42 with `rcx` = p, zeroes qword `rcx+0x570` and clears bit 1 of word `rcx+0x57E` (`AND 0xfffd`); otherwise it returns after the first part

notes: 002BE290: in all three calls rcx is the incoming rcx (kept in rbx) except the third, where rcx is still the qword loaded from rcx+0x570; no return value is set by the body itself.
